dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth margins with a minor convex curvature on the mid-left lateral edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity light-grey to white tone consistent with a mature dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey patches visible on the anterior head region and along the central dorsal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between slightly darker mottled regions and the lighter primary skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular point corresponding to the blowhole; no other distinct lesions or marks visible.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Topological indentation at the blowhole site and a faint linear depression along the posterior dorsal ridge.
